verdict.rationale: Pipecat Flows documents functions that interface with external systems and APIs during a conversation, with metadata auto-derived from signatures and docstrings. The site also says long-running tools can be handed off to subagents, which implies the bot can keep talking while work runs, but no mechanism for avoiding dead air is actually documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how tool latency is masked (filler speech or async/non-blocking function results), core-framework function calling outside Flows, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: Process data by interfacing with external systems and APIs
Flows auto-derives the function's metadata — name, description, parameter properties (with their descriptions), and which parameters are required — from the function's signature and docstring.
Hand off to subagents for long-running tools and complex tasks
